instructions: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
GROWING FOOD IN CITIES

Background
• 19th-century laws forced councils to supply rented plots, which the Acts themselves call (31) ........
• the number of plots then dropped for half a century

Three forms today
• the commonest form sits on ground that planning documents term (32) ........
• a farm on the flat roof of an existing building
• an indoor farm lit by lamps

What the survey found
• a typical shared garden covers roughly (33) ........ square metres
• a realistic yield is about (34) ........ times that of a field, and only for salad and soft fruit

What it does for the city
• a planted roof held back about (35) ........ of one heavy downpour
• the benefit named most often: (36) ........ with other people (exercise came second)

items.prompt: 19th-century laws forced councils to supply rented plots, which the Acts themselves call (31) ........
items.evidence: the word the Acts themselves use is field gardens
items.explanation: Everyone says allotments today, but the speaker points out that the term written into the nineteenth-century Acts is field gardens, and tells the listener to write that one down.

items.prompt: the commonest form sits on ground that planning documents term (32) ........
items.evidence: the word in the planning documents is meanwhile land
items.explanation: The press calls this kind of unused ground brownfield, but the speaker says the term used in the planning documents themselves is meanwhile land.

items.prompt: a typical shared garden covers roughly (33) ........ square metres
items.evidence: the median community garden occupied about two thousand square metres and supplied around thirty households
items.explanation: The same survey also cites 5,000 square metres, but that figure includes paths, sheds and the car park; the median value is 2,000 square metres.

items.prompt: a realistic yield is about (34) ........ times that of a field, and only for salad and soft fruit
items.evidence: More careful work puts the realistic figure at about three times
items.explanation: For years a yield of fifteen times was claimed; more careful studies put the realistic figure at about three times.
items.blind_note: Sessiz olcum araci govde cakismasi uyarisiyla bu kalemi kirletti; olcum disi birakildi, soru degistirilmedi.

items.prompt: a planted roof held back about (35) ........ of one heavy downpour
items.evidence: around half of a heavy shower was retained rather than running straight into the drains
items.explanation: Measurements on a trial building show that about half of a heavy downpour was held back by the planted roof.
items.blind_note: Sessiz olcum araci govde cakismasi uyarisiyla bu kalemi kirletti; olcum disi birakildi, soru degistirilmedi.

items.prompt: the benefit named most often: (36) ........ with other people (exercise came second)
items.evidence: the benefit participants reported most often was not the food at all, but the contact with other people
items.explanation: Sixty-eight per cent of the gardeners in the study named contact with other people; exercise came second and saving money came last.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: L1 dinleme - sizinti onarimi (yalniz kok / secenek / cerceve)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: what gardeners mentioned most was (36) ........ with other people, not the food
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: 'bahçıvanların en çok andığı şey (36), yemek değil' çerçevesi 'başka insanlarla' kaydıyla birleşince boşluğa insan ilişkisi dışında aday bırakmıyor.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Cevap (contact) ve dayanak noktasi ayni; degisen yalnizca not satiri. Eski cerceve 'yemek degil' karsitligini kendi icinde tasiyordu; 'baska insanlarla' kaydiyla birleserek bosluga insan iliskisi disinda aday birakmiyordu. Karsitlik cerceveden cikarilip sese birakildi - konusmada zaten 'not the food at all, but the contact with other people' diye geciyor. Cerceve notrlestirildi ve yerine, cevabi ele vermeyen ama dinleyene yer gosteren bir ayrinti kondu: egzersizin ikinci sirada gelmesi.
